criteria.requirement: Specify language/stdlib/toolchain versioning and compatibility for bytecode, native signatures, packages and contracts.
Provide reproducible dependency resolution and explicit upgrade/migration behavior without silent semantic changes.
Ensure optional integration absence produces typed predictable failure rather than uncaught host exceptions.
Test old/new compiler-runtime combinations, stale artifacts, dependency upgrades and clean installation/rollback.
Retain reviewed design decisions, implementation references, meaningful regression/end-to-end tests, and failure evidence appropriate to this scope.
For performance/data claims, freeze workload/source identities before tuning, compare with an independent oracle, and report actual limits and unsuccessful trials.
Update user-facing documentation and the architecture tracker; do not equate finite passing tests with universal correctness or security.

publication_gates: Verify final full regression and source hashes
Final-head Linux/macOS Python3.11/3.14 CI including installed-pair step
Merge and update original issue and parent tracker with immutable evidence
